name: com.engineedge.smartdictionary
description: A fully serializable, Inspector-friendly generic Dictionary for Unity with LINQ support, events, safe access API, merge operations, JSON/PlayerPrefs serialization, and 5 bonus collection types (HashSet, Stack, Queue, OrderedDictionary, BiDictionary).

samples.description: Demonstrates MonoBehaviour inventory and ScriptableObject GameConfig usage.
Demonstrates LINQ extension methods and reactive events on dictionary mutation.
Demonstrates JSON file I/O and PlayerPrefs persistence.
Demonstrates SerializableHashSet, Stack, Queue, OrderedDict, and BiDictionary.
